creatures.jaymoskingdoms.garlic_door: The garlic over the door turns you back.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.260: Wild garlic grows in forests and swamps, and farmers sell it. Plant it on soil and it comes back. A vampire flinches from a head of garlic held out to it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.261: A garlic wreath worn at the neck or on the head makes a vampire's bite slip off you, and its grab can't hold you. Hung by a door, no vampire comes through, invited or not. It withers in three days.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.262: Garlic in an awkward potion brews a garlic draught. While it lasts, a vampire that bites you retches, lets go and gets nothing from the bite.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.263: A hunter's coat turns most bites aside, and no vampire can grab whoever wears it. A village tailor sells one.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.264: The Lantern Warden's priests sell the hunter's kit to anyone who has slain a vampire: the coat, a garlic wreath and a blade oil of garlic and silver for the cursed.
